issues.reason: PartOf is defined only over individuals (a component of an object, a member of a group), so putting the kind symbol spring_tide -- used as a class on the left of (Inheritance spring_tide tide) -- into its first slot beside the individual witness sk_lunar_cycle_1 both mixes the class and individual levels the Member/Inheritance discipline exists to keep apart and asserts that a kind is a part of one particular cycle.

gaps_confirmed: equative / specifying copular whose predicate is a definite plural NP: the identity and exhaustiveness of 'are THE large tides' have no carrier, so the predicate can only be shredded into separate property atoms
a definite of-phrase restricting a KIND-level subject: the licensed genitive encodings (PartOf / Possession) are stated only over individuals, with no kind-level counterpart
new_gaps: there is no kind-level part-whole or containment head at all -- PartOf, LocatedIn and During are individual-level, and the kind-relation route of Striking & relational generics fires only when BOTH arguments are bare kind NPs -- so a relation between a kind and a definite individual ('the lunar cycle') has no licensed carrier in either direction
defect_summary: The compliant parse keeps the genus, the large property and the lunar-cycle typing atoms and omits the of-restrictor with the gap recorded: no licensed form relates a kind to a definite individual, since PartOf/Possession are individual-level and the bare-kinds relational-generic route is blocked by the definite 'the lunar cycle'.
notes: Everything else is doctrinal: spring_tide and lunar_cycle fuse as terms of art with the head genus always emitted, and the noun modifier 'spring' and the relational adjective 'lunar' are correctly left unexposed. Dropping the definite 'the' narrows rather than widens the claim, so it is a recorded loss, not an over-assertion.
